name: Role task breakdown for AI help
why: Breaks a job into tasks and shows where AI can help with a person in charge, the first step of the task map skill.

name: Give AI tasks and keep what the job quietly does
why: Finds what each task quietly protects before handing it to AI, matching the intake question about judgement and care.

name: AI-fit problem checker
why: Tests whether AI fits a problem at all and suggests a small first proof, before any pilot is planned.

name: AI tool picker
why: Matches a job to the type of AI tool that fits, the same tool-type-first approach as the task map.

name: Prepare an AI pilot go decision
why: Turns pilot results into a go or stop decision, alongside the pilot results review prompt.

name: AI pilot evaluation review assistant
why: A repeatable agent for reviewing pilot evidence against agreed criteria.

name: Tune a prompt with real tests, then keep versions
why: Tests prompts against real cases and keeps versions, the method behind the team prompt library.

name: Rough prompt rebuilder
why: A quick way for trainees to turn a weak prompt into a clear one during workshop practice rounds.

name: Automation flow sketcher
why: Turns a repeated task into a Zapier or Make plan with failure handling, a starting point for the workflow redesign skill.

name: Check a new automation before relying on it
why: Tests a new automation before it goes live, the step before turning on a workflow at level 3.

name: Harden an AI app against hijacked prompts and runaway bills
why: Covers prompt injection defences and spending caps for teams building their own AI tools.

name: Make a new policy understandable to staff
why: Helps roll out the AI use policy in plain words staff will read.

name: Training handout writer
why: Turns workshop notes into a one-page desk handout with steps and common mistakes.

name: Check training transfer after a course
why: Checks whether people use what they learned, matching the skills check a month after the workshop.
